questions.solution_md:
Shar radiusi: $\frac43\pi R^3=\frac{256}{3}\pi$, bundan $R^3=64$, $R=4$.

O'q kesimi radiusi $R$ bo'lgan aylanaga chizilgan teng tomonli uchburchak: balandligi $h=\frac{3R}{2}=6$, tomoni $R\sqrt3$, asos radiusi $r=\frac{R\sqrt3}{2}$, $r^2=\frac{3R^2}{4}=12$.

$V=\frac13\pi r^2h=\frac13\pi\cdot12\cdot6=24\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teng tomonli uchburchakning balandligi $\frac{3R}{2}$ ekanini unutib, balandlikni $R$ yoki $2R$ deb olish.

ru.solution_md:
Радиус шара: $\frac43\pi R^3=\frac{32}{3}\pi$, откуда $R^3=8$, $R=2$.

Осевое сечение — равносторонний треугольник, вписанный в окружность радиуса $R$: высота $h=\frac{3R}{2}=3$, сторона $R\sqrt3$, радиус основания $r=\frac{R\sqrt3}{2}$, $r^2=\frac{3R^2}{4}=3$.

$V=\frac13\pi r^2h=\frac13\pi\cdot3\cdot3=3\pi$.

en.solution_md:

en.stem_md: A cone is inscribed in a ball of volume $\frac{4000}{3}\pi$: its apex and the circle of its base lie on the sphere, and its axial section is an equilateral triangle. Find the volume of the cone.

en.solution_md:
The radius of the ball: $\frac43\pi R^3=\frac{4000}{3}\pi$, so $R^3=1000$ and $R=10$.

The axial section is an equilateral triangle inscribed in a circle of radius $R$: its height is $h=\frac{3R}{2}=15$, its side is $R\sqrt3$, the base radius is $r=\frac{R\sqrt3}{2}$, $r^2=\frac{3R^2}{4}=75$.

$V=\frac13\pi r^2h=\frac13\pi\cdot75\cdot15=375\pi$.
